def solve():
    mod = 998244353
    n = int(input())
    K = int(input())
    if K >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    fif = enumFIF(250000, mod)
    if K == 0:
        print(fif[0][n])
        return

    ans = 0
    for i in range(n - K, 0, -1):
        s = 1 if (n - K - i) % 2 == 0 else mod - 1
        ans += C(n, i, mod, fif) * pow_mod(i, n, mod) % mod * s % mod * C(n - i, K, mod, fif)
        ans %= mod
    ans = ans * 2 % mod
    print(ans)

def pow_mod(a, n, mod):
    ret = 1
    x = n.bit_length() - 1
    for x in range(x, -1, -1):
        ret = ret * ret % mod
        if (n >> x) & 1:
            ret = ret * a % mod
    return ret

def C(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n - r] % mod

def enumFIF(n, mod):
    f = [1] * (n + 1)
    invf = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod
    a = f[n]
    b = mod
    p, q = 1, 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        d = p
        p = q
        q = d - c * q
    invf[n] = p % mod
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod
    return [f, invf]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
